Method of Attack: Malvertising campaign that bypasses ad blockers to deliver malicious payloads
Uses aggressive fingerprinting including browser type, OS, language, geolocation, and user-agent detection
Redirects users through multiple URLs performing various checks
Delivers diverse payloads including exploit kits (RIG EG, Magnitude), tech support scam pages, Mac adware, Windows PUPs, rogue Chrome extensions, pay-per-install schemes, and online surveys
Impacted Systems: Users of browsers with ad blockers such as Adblock Plus, uBlock Origin, AdGuard
Websites including Adf.ly, ExtraTorrent, Openloud, Ouo.io, and smaller hacked or compromised sites
Attack Vector: Malicious ads inserted into thousands of websites' ad spaces
Malicious code loaded in browser background scripts
Indicators of Compromise: RoughTed-tainted ads on Adf.ly, ExtraTorrent, Openloud, Ouo.io
Scripts performing fingerprinting and ad blocker detection
URLs redirecting through tens of domains
